caption: I noticed some people use mouthwash before brushing their teeth, while others use it after. I wonder what's the best time to use mouthwash 🤔💦
comments_seeded: Do you think the order of mouthwash and toothpaste makes a difference in how clean our mouths feel?
I've heard some people use mouthwash at night to help prevent morning breath, but is that really a thing?
What's your daily routine like when it comes to mouthwash and brushing - do you use them together or separate?
It's interesting to think about how something as simple as mouthwash timing could affect our oral health, right?
Have you ever noticed any differences in your teeth or gums based on when you use mouthwash in your daily routine?
